blockers.problem: The historical frequency proxy counts prefixes after deleting terminal Tamil vowel marks.
blockers.action: Integrate exact written-form counts or a separately reviewed inflection-aware measure into both proposal and null-pool features in a new scorer version.
blockers.acceptance: All proposal and control features use the same frozen measure; unit counterexamples and independent feature replay pass. No historical output is overwritten.

blockers.problem: Of 24 proposed forms, 15 have multiple exact dictionary records and aṟu has no exact one-member entry. The former code selected first rows or a collapsed-form fallback.
blockers.action: Have a Dravidian specialist adjudicate lexeme, sense and earliest attestation wherever the proposed meaning or native-noun filter depends on them, including homographs and any numeral allomorph. Written-form counts may aggregate homographs without choosing a sense. Preserve unresolved cases and the excluded set.
blockers.acceptance: Every accepted mapping has source edition, page, stable entry ID, sense, historical-period basis and signed adjudication. A variant cannot be justified solely by the scorer's phonological tolerance.

blockers.problem: Whole-file Sangam HTML tokens include any Tamil front matter and editorial text; exact written forms omit inflections and sandhi.
blockers.action: Build a line-addressable poetry-only source extract and a separately reviewed list of complete attested variants. Record original line text locally and line IDs in results.
blockers.acceptance: A source-blind sample verifies text boundaries and the matching rule. Form frequency and sense attestation remain separate measurements.

blockers.problem: Winslow's parser misses -am-increment compounds and principal compounds without etymologies, and gives jamīṉ a two-member split.
blockers.action: Audit a stratified sample of accepted and rejected compounds across the dictionary before changing junction rules; add the known failures to a held regression set.
blockers.acceptance: Versioned manual gold set, precision and recall by compound class, every alternative retained, no selected-word-only patch. The reviewed table is frozen before a new assay.

blockers.problem: The available Parpola inventory uses five later papers, 16 signs and 24 distinct word forms. The full 1994 inventory and all sign-code crosswalks remain unavailable or unresolved.
blockers.action: Obtain lawful access to the 1994 book and build a versioned extraction of every proposed identification, including negative and alternative cases, with reviewed sign crosswalks.
blockers.acceptance: A complete source inventory and explicit exclusions; every code supported by a glyph or located object observation, with ambiguous mappings retained.

blockers.problem: The shared harness has key and meaning-map tasks but no calibrated rebus task with comparable correct and wrong controls.
blockers.action: Implement a separate rebus task, preserving whole-key replacement dependence and equal choice budgets, and run the prespecified calibration campaign.
blockers.owner_role: evaluation implementer and independent methods reviewer
blockers.acceptance: Known-correct controls pass with stated power, wrong controls meet the error-rate rule, and dictionary coverage changes do not silently change the target. Family-specific effect and pass rules are frozen.

blockers.problem: Current physical identities are provisional and exposure is unreviewed. Absence from the spending ledger does not establish a fresh object.
blockers.action: Close aliases and faces, construct separate text-dependence components, and record object and statistic-family exposure before reserving a genuinely unexamined cohort.
blockers.acceptance: Reviewed eligibility file with inclusion/exclusion reasons and hashes; every reserved component has known identity and an exposure review. All participants freeze before access.
blockers.register_dependency: Versioned object register with independently reviewed identity and exposure; pin the reviewed run when registering participants

blockers.problem: Meaning-map outcomes need independently measured object properties, with source conflicts, missingness and site proxies controlled.
blockers.action: Export source assertions for the declared dimensions, material, context or use outcomes and audit joins independently of the reading. Define eligible components and missingness rules on discovery.
blockers.acceptance: A signed variable dictionary, independent measurement provenance, sufficient component counts and a site-proxy audit where geography is predicted.

blockers.problem: Language-model projection, training genre and deletion freedom affect Sanskrit-key comparisons, and different proposals cover different sign sets.
blockers.action: Use the final paper 006 repairs, freeze projection/model sensitivity conditions and deletion budgets, and compare common populations or prespecified coverage strata.
blockers.acceptance: Pinned training/test separation, complete emission counts, same option-list freedom, source-specific exclusions and fixed unrelated-language controls.

blockers.problem: No complete shared roster, joint testing rule or adequate calibration campaign has been frozen.
blockers.action: Finalize the participation contract, evaluate correct and wrong controls under the same source/freedom laws, then register every participant and freeze all artifacts before opening confirmation.
blockers.acceptance: Reviewed calibration report and source/exposure decisions; complete shared shots manifest, joint credence rule, immutable artifacts and access log.
